en.headline: Election Committee results begin to emerge after 98.79 per cent turnout
en.dek: Counting continues at the Convention Centre; the Law Society president and General Chamber chief executive were not among those elected in their subsectors.
body: Results from the Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections began to be announced on Sunday evening as counting proceeded at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

Polls closed at 6pm with 5,640 of 5,709 eligible electors having voted, a turnout of 98.79 per cent, according to the Electoral Affairs Commission. The figure exceeded the previous election's final turnout.

In the legal subsector, where 16 candidates contested 15 seats, Law Society president Tang Man-lung was not elected. In the commercial (first) subsector, General Chamber of Commerce chief executive Yeung Wai-tim was not among the 17 elected from 19 candidates, while figures including Jeffrey Lam Kin-fung and Jeny Yeung Mei-chun were returned.

Electoral Affairs Commission chairman David Lok earlier described the high turnout as encouraging. Officials said counting was expected to finish within a reasonable time, aided by electronic scanners.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉點票結果陸續公布 投票率達98.79%
zh.dek: 會展中央點票站繼續點票；律師會會長湯文龍及總商會總裁楊偉添在所屬界別落選。
body: 選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉結果周日傍晚開始陸續公布，點票工作在香港會議展覽中心中央點票站進行。
選舉事務處表示，投票於下午6時結束，5709名合資格投票人中有5640人投票，臨時累積投票率為98.79%，高於上屆最終投票率。
法律界由16名候選人競逐15席，律師會會長湯文龍未能當選。商界（第一）由19人競逐17席，總商會總裁楊偉添落選，林健鋒、楊美珍等則當選。
選管會主席陸啟康早前形容高投票率令人鼓舞。官員表示，在電子點票機協助下，有信心在合理時間內完成點票。
